Item.Overview: The Kill Bill Collection is a series of thrilling revenge dramas directed by Quentin Tarantino. Inspired by Hong Kong martial arts movies, Japanese samurai films, and Italian spaghetti westerns, these movies are characterized by their stylized violence, pop culture references, and extensive use of popular music. Featuring Uma Thurman in the iconic role of The Bride, the Kill Bill films have become cult classics that continue to captivate audiences worldwide.
